phrases.def: 可持续发展和可持续可持续发展,

sentences.en: A For more than forty years the cost of food has been rising.
sentences.zh: 40多年来,粮食成本一直在上涨。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It has now reached a point where a growing number of people believe that it is far too high, and that bringing it down will be one of the great challenges of the twenty first century.
sentences.zh: 现在已到了这样一个地步,越来越多的人认为,它太高,而降低它将是二十一世纪的重大挑战之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: That cost, however, is not in immediate cash.
sentences.zh: 然而,这一费用不是现成现金。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the West at least, most food is now far cheaper to buy in relative terms than it was in 1960.
sentences.zh: 至少西方国家现在购买的粮食比1960年便宜得多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The cost is in the collateral damage of the very methods of food production that have made the food cheaper: in the pollution of water, the enervation of soil, the destruction of wildlife, the harm to animal welfare and the threat to human health caused by modern industrial agriculture.
sentences.zh: 其代价在于粮食生产方法的附带损害,这些方法使粮食价格更低:水污染、土壤密集、野生动物破坏、动物福利损害以及现代工业农业对人类健康造成的威胁。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B First mechanisation, then mass use of chemical fertilisers and pesticides, then monocultures, then battery rearing of livestock, and now genetic engineering – the onward march of intensive farming has seemed unstoppable in the last half-century, as the yields of produce have soared.
sentences.zh: 首先是机械化,然后是大规模使用化学肥料和杀虫剂,然后是单种作物,然后是养殖电池,然后是饲养牲畜,现在又是基因工程 — — 集中耕作的前进征程在过去半个世纪中似乎无法阻挡,因为产量已经飞涨。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But the damage it has caused has been colossal.
sentences.zh: 但是它造成的破坏是巨大的

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In Britain, for example, many of our best-loved farmland birds, such as the skylark, the grey partridge, the lapwing and the corn bunting, have vanished from huge stretches of countryside, as have even more wild flowers and insects.
sentences.zh: 例如,在英国,许多我们最喜爱的农地鸟类,如天花板、灰色的半脊、斜翼和玉米卷发,从乡村的广阔地带消失,更多的野生花和昆虫也消失。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is a direct result of the way we have produced our food in the last four decades.
sentences.zh: 这是我们过去40年来生产粮食的方式的直接结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Thousands of miles of hedgerows, thousands of ponds, have disappeared from the landscape.
sentences.zh: 数千英里的对冲沟数千个池塘已经从地表消失

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The faecal filth of salmon farming has driven wild salmon from many of the sea lochs and rivers of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 养殖鲑鱼的粪便污秽驱散了苏格兰许多海湖和河流的野生鲑鱼

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Natural soil fertility is dropping in many areas because of continuous industrial fertiliser and pesticide use, while the growth of algae is increasing in lakes because of the fertiliser run-off.
sentences.zh: 由于工业化肥和杀虫剂的使用,许多地区的自然土壤肥力不断下降,而由于化肥径流,湖中的藻类生长正在增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: C Put it all together and it looks like a battlefield, but consumers rarely make the connection at the dinner table.
sentences.zh: C组装起来,看起来像战场, 但消费者很少在餐桌上搭上。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: That is mainly because the costs of all this damage are what economists refer to as externalities: they are outside the main transaction, which is for example producing and selling a field of wheat, and are borne directly by neither producers nor consumers.
sentences.zh: 这主要是因为所有这些损害的代价都是经济学家称之为外部效应:它们不属于主要交易范围,例如生产和销售小麦,既不由生产者,也不由消费者直接承担。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: To many, the costs may not even appear to be financial at all, but merely aesthetic – a terrible shame, but nothing to do with money.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为,代价甚至可能根本不是财政成本,而只是美学 — — 令人非常羞耻,但与金钱无关。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And anyway they, as consumers of food, certainly aren’t paying for it, are they?
sentences.zh: 以食物消费为目的,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: D But the costs to society can actually be quantified and, when added up, can amount to staggering sums.
sentences.zh: 但社会成本实际上可以量化,加起来,可以达到惊人的金额。

sentences.en: A remarkable exercise in doing this has been carried out by one of the world’s leading thinkers on the future of agriculture, Professor Jules Pretty, Director of the Centre for Environment and Society at the University of Essex.
sentences.zh: 从事这项工作的杰出人士是世界农业未来主要思想家之一、埃塞克斯大学环境与社会中心主任朱尔斯·普雷特教授。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Professor Pretty and his colleagues calculated the externalities of British agriculture for one particular year.
sentences.zh: 漂亮教授和他的同事计算了一年英国农业的外在因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They added up the costs of repairing the damage it caused, and came up with a total figure of £2,343m.
sentences.zh: 他们加起来修复造成的损坏的费用,合计2 343万英镑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is equivalent to £208 for every hectare of arable land and permanent pasture, almost as much again as the total government and EU spend on British farming in that year.
sentences.zh: 每公顷可耕地和永久牧场的这一数额相当于208英镑,几乎相当于当年英国政府和欧盟用于英国农业的全部开支。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And according to Professor Pretty, it was a conservative estimate.
sentences.zh: 据Prett教授说那是保守的估计

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E The costs included: £120m for removal of pesticides; £16m for removal of nitrates; £55m for removal of phosphates and soil; £23m for the removal of the bug Cryptosporidium from drinking water by water companies; £125m for damage to wildlife habitats, hedgerows and dry stone walls; £1,113m from emissions of gases likely to contribute to climate change; £106m from soil erosion and organic carbon losses; £169m from food poisoning; and £607m from cattle disease.
sentences.zh: E 这些费用包括:清除杀虫剂1.2亿英镑;清除硝酸盐1.6亿英镑;清除磷酸盐和土壤2.5亿英镑;水公司将虫子加密从饮用水中清除2 300万英镑;对野生动物生境、树篱和干岩墙的破坏125万英镑;可能助长气候变化的气体排放11.13亿英镑;土壤侵蚀和有机碳损失1.06亿英镑;食物中毒1.69亿英镑;牛病60 700万英镑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Professor Pretty draws a simple but memorable conclusion from all this: our food bills are actually threefold.
sentences.zh: 教授Preaty从所有这些中得出了一个简单但令人难忘的结论: 我们的食物账单实际上有三重。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We are paying for our supposedly cheaper food in three separate ways: once over the counter, secondly through our taxes, which provide the enormous subsidies propping up modern intensive farming, and thirdly to clean up the mess that modern farming leaves behind.
sentences.zh: 我们以三种不同的方式支付我们所谓的廉价食品:一过柜台,二过我们的税收,这些税收提供巨额补贴,支持现代密集耕作,第三,清理现代耕作留下的混乱。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: F So can the true cost of food be brought down?
sentences.zh: 粮食的真实成本能降低吗?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Breaking away from industrial agriculture as the solution to hunger may be very hard for some countries, but in Britain, where the immediate need to supply food is less urgent, and the costs and the damage of intensive farming have been clearly seen, it may be more feasible.
sentences.zh: 脱离工业农业,因为解决饥饿问题对一些国家来说可能非常困难,但在英国,供应粮食的迫切需要并不那么紧迫,密集耕作的成本和破坏已经清楚地看到,这样做可能比较可行。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The government needs to create sustainable, competitive and diverse farming and food sectors, which will contribute to a thriving and sustainable rural economy, and advance environmental, economic, health, and animal welfare goals.
sentences.zh: 政府需要建立可持续、有竞争力和多样化的农牧业和食品部门,这将有助于繁荣和可持续的农村经济,推动环境、经济、卫生和动物福利目标。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: He is recommending the immediate introduction of a ‘Greener Food Standard’, which would push the market towards more sustainable environmental practices than the current norm, while not requiring the full commitment to organic production.
sentences.zh: 他建议立即采用 " 绿色食品标准 ",这将推动市场采用比目前标准更可持续的环境做法,同时不要求充分致力于有机生产。

sentences.en: Such a standard would comprise agreed practices for different kinds of farming, covering agrochemical use, soil health, land management, water and energy use, food safety and animal health.
